trap.label: pedir informação (produção)
trap.wrong: Could you tell me where I can buy a ticket? Do you know what time does the train leave? I wonder if there is a discount.
trap.right: Do you know what time the train leaves?
trap.why: Em português “que horas o trem sai?” mantém a ordem. Em inglês, a pergunta indireta usa ordem afirmativa e sem do/does.

mcq.q: Could you tell me how long ___?
I wonder ___ there is a discount.

fix.wrong: Do you know what time does it open?
fix.right: Do you know what time it opens?

fix.wrong: I wonder is there a seat.
fix.right: I wonder if there is a seat.

fix.wrong: Could you tell me where is Platform 2?
fix.right: Could you tell me where Platform 2 is?

rewrite.prompt: Torne indireta: “What time does it close?” (Do you know...)
rewrite.answer: Do you know what time it closes?

rewrite.prompt: Torne indireta: “Is there a discount?” (I wonder...)
rewrite.answer: I wonder if there is a discount.

rewrite.prompt: Torne indireta: “Where can I buy a ticket?” (Could you tell me...)
rewrite.answer: Could you tell me where I can buy a ticket?
